text:
A ray of light passes from air into a block of glass. The critical angle is 42°.
Which statement is correct?
A
The angle of incidence is the angle between the ray of light and the surface of the glass
block.
B
The angle of incidence is always bigger than 42°.
C
The angle of refraction cannot be less than 42°.
D
The angle of refraction is smaller than the angle of incidence.

options.label: A
options.text: The angle of incidence is the angle between the ray of light and the surface of the glass

options.label: B
options.text: The angle of incidence is always bigger than 42°.

options.label: C
options.text: The angle of refraction cannot be less than 42°.

options.label: D
options.text: The angle of refraction is smaller than the angle of incidence.
